verdicts.reason: A and B are pixel-identical. In both, the body copy sits over the green circle, pressed against the left canvas edge, and reads before the headline. The circle has come apart from the can, which has shrunk to a tiny icon with an unreadable label. The SOLSTICE wordmark sits below the headline, so the reading order is reversed. The CTA and the two badge pills are crammed edge to edge with no gutters, and roughly the right 150px of the canvas is empty.
